engineWorkingDefaults.description: Stolen initialization, private caster counters, child action slots, direct init bonuses and maintained effects use explicit origins. Expiry removes these; already completed casts finish naturally. Copied permanent charges are temporary snapshots and never write rewards to a purchased skill instance.

Official FAQ excludes ordinary summons from default hero attacks. Forced targeting and spell targeting remain possible; real heroes, their scheduled revivals and hero illusions determine survival. Hero-illusion classification is an explicit engine interpretation.

Attack animation/cadence and cast windup/backswing retain completed progress when explicit time scales change. Chronosphere channels, cooldowns, periodic effects and projectiles remain on world time; channel scaling is not stated by the AA text.

Jingu soldiers use an explicit seven-skill attack-effect allowlist without recursive Jingu. Moon Glaives use the impact-time base attack snapshot and serial bounces. Skeletons sample their declared damage interval. Empower uses the historical taper, with Super +200 interpreted as ending half-width.

engineReferenceValidation: Original-version status/immune/dispel ordering, illusion inheritance allowlists and aura stacking groups remain unverified.
Non-caster custom program counters require per-effect collision tests; Spell Steal does not generically sandbox arbitrary writes into battle or target objects.

Four legacy PRD entries retain working eligibility. Walrus Punch and Anchor Smash additionally have historical Wiki changelog eligibility evidence; exact AA initial counters and coefficient conventions still need comparison.

referenceResearch.policy: AA explicit values and approved project customizations take priority. Current Wiki is research evidence, not an automatic numerical update to the historical AA catalog.

pages.application: Separate mechanical windup from visual clip length; preserve interrupted windup resource semantics.
Require facing before eligible movement/attack/cast. Four custom bodies use a configurable 18rad/s work value and 11.5 degree tolerance; the native acceleration curve is not verified.
Timing reference only; retain the AA damage, stun and upgrade values.
Chance-based critical sources roll in descending multiplier order and stop at the first success; never multiply simultaneous critical factors.
Recheck unit-targeted release range with the historical motion buffer; zero-windup casts do not gain a motion buffer.
Cleave is attributed to its provider while preserving physical spell damage and the no-spell-amplification/no-spell-lifesteal exceptions.
Projectile-driven continuous travel may explicitly pass impassable terrain. Its moving body and damaging path must stay synchronized; modern facets and numerical changes are not imported.
Independent evasion sources combine through complementary probabilities. Blind is a separate additive group; map elevation is outside this project scope.
Independent duration-resistance sources combine multiplicatively; newly applied effects use current resistance. Per-effect and aura exceptions remain explicit.
Default total attack speed is constrained to 20–700 with explicit ability overrides; the project's minimum interval is a separately labeled configurable work safeguard.
Ordinary movement uses the historical 100–550 native-unit limits. Stationary bodies remain stationary, and explicit absolute movement effects use their own rules.
Attack/spell classification and physical/magical/pure damage types are independent. Health setting and damage flags must not be inferred from a skill ID.
Separate basic and strong dispel and explicit persistence exceptions; aura lifetime is owned by its source.
Keep post-reduction damage and effective-healing contributions until final settlement, with original ownership and kill-credit order. Do not apply ordinary mitigation twice.
7.33 introduced major immunity changes after the chosen historical candidate; do not silently migrate the AA snapshot to modern debuff immunity.
Use compact ordinary damage and emphasized critical text as presentation reference. Physical/magical/pure colors are an approved project extension.
